# eIPC

> llms.txt for the eIPC repository (embeddedos-org/eIPC).
> Status: secure inter-process communication for EmbeddedOS,
> implemented in Go — authenticated channels, per-tenant
> isolation, and the protocol TensorRegistry for zero-copy
> tensor transport between processes.

eIPC is the IPC layer of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem: the mechanism
by which processes, services and (in the Track 1 design) loadable
ML modules exchange data with declared capabilities, without
ambient authority.
